reader_summary.overview: On this Company episode of The Synopsis we draw on our 75-page research report on Axon Enterprises, a leading law enforcement technology provider. Founder Rick Smith took a failed concept—the TASER—and not only created a succesful business around it, but made it become a mainstay of policing.

key_points.text: On this Company episode of The Synopsis we draw on our 75-page research report on Axon Enterprises, a leading law enforcement technology provider.
Not content to just reinvent how policing worked in the field, Axon pushed into other critical areas of law enforcement like officer video.
A 1,000x return since going public in 2001, Axon is one of the highest returning stocks of all time.
